# Petya Andromeda D8: D7 plus its weak correction families

D7 became the group's D (37/54 new, 34/42 v22, 795/801 familiar) but lost five held-out drafts D1 wrote well: a lost
«не для входа» for a one-time code, invented document names for two copies, «назначение» instead of the kept field, and
wrong summaries for a permission and a quote. D8 continues D7 with the recipe that worked for D7 (lr 5e-7) on the
familiar cases once plus 20 training dialogues from each of those five families. `prepare.py` freezes `train.jsonl`
and `protocol.json`; `Train Petya.app` runs `execution.json` into `~/.petya-train/andromeda-d8`.

## Result: the group's D

| | D1 | D7 | D8 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 54 generated held-out drafts | 24 | 37 (14 exact) | **39** (19 exact) |
| 42 v22 cases (30 checks + 12 drafts) | 27 + 6 | 28 + 6 | **28 + 7** |
| 801 familiar cases | 787 | 795 | **795** |

Not worse than D7 on any set; four of the five D1 successes D7 lost are back (three D1 successes are still lost).
Since 9 November 2026 the group is Petya Andromeda R1-A1-D8; D7 and D1 stay published for rollback.
